title: stepscroll graphics
description: What the display list draws: every graphic is drawn exactly as it is here, by a tile's entry naming it in tiles.json -- the step, and whatever sky, rock, margin rows and spare bytes round it a move needs; the build adds nothing. In named groups, each graphic keyed by a name of its own, unique across all groups. See step_graphics.py.

direction.description: The direction of the steps its graphics were made for, as a reminder; the build doesn't use it.

rows.description: The bitmap, rows from the top: '#' a set pixel, '.' a clear one. 1 to 3 bytes wide (the blitters'), an even number of rows from 2 to 16 (the blitters go up a row pair at a time).

shiftIn.description: What comes in on the left as the graphic is pre-shifted right for fine positions 2, 4 and 6: 6 pixels a row, the last 2, 4 or all 6 of them. A row for each of the graphic's rows.
